passage:
To: Project team
From: Mina Park, Operations
Subject: Revised maintenance window

The network maintenance originally planned for Thursday evening has been moved to Friday, 8:00–9:30 P.M. The vendor needs an additional day to test the replacement switch. No action is required from team members, but please save your work before leaving on Friday. I will send a completion notice after access is restored.
prompt: What are team members asked to do?
choices: Disconnect their computers before Thursday evening.
Save their work before leaving on Friday.
Test the replacement switch with the vendor.
Send a completion notice to Operations.
explanation: Team members are asked to save work before leaving Friday.
quick_solution: Team members are asked to save work before leaving Friday.
